item.text:
Audited `alam-ko-uncha-rakhna.md` verse by verse against the Urdu. Corrected Roman spellings, izafat, nasal endings, and wording mismatches, including `baarah aayateṅ` and an extra `hai`. The Urdu body and metadata were preserved, and every Roman verse aligns with its source line.

The reading `wa hijaaba` follows the supplied Urdu spelling and remains open to editorial confirmation.
